blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National University-Archipelago Builders vented its ire on 3B, 25-16, 25-20, 25-12, to move closer to the semifinal round in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Tuesday at Philsports Arena. The Bulldogs missed the services of Buds Buddin due to a toe injury, but Luke Macatangay stepped up with an all-around game of seven points, 16 excellent receptions, and five digs to help them bounce back from a straight-set loss to Savouge last Sunday. The incoming second-year spiker, the son of former Southeast Asian Games silver and bronze medalist and women’s national volleyball team player Cherry Macatangay, said […]...
